2. Learn automation basics by completing an 'Automation with Python' tutorial on YouTube.
3. Explore AI concepts by taking an 'Introduction to AI' course on Coursera, focusing on training and evaluation.
4. Practice quality assurance by contributing to an open-source project on GitHub, writing test cases.
5. Build a portfolio project that combines API development, automation, and AI evaluation, then apply for internships.
